why: Main-app script names of the versions published before the main service worker stopped answering for /maths/ (commit ba9f941). An old offline copy of the main app serves its own page at /exam-prep/maths/, and that page asks for ./assets/<one of these>. The maths build puts a small repair script under each name: it removes the old offline copy and reloads, so the maths app opens. Progress (IndexedDB) is not touched.
